examples.text: Er will seine ganze Generation zernichten.
Gestern hat Hasu alle global zernichtet.

glosses: To reduce to nothing, to destroy, to eradicate.

examples.text: An atom bomb can annihilate a whole city.

But eagerness in this case, as in most others, annihilated its own delight; down came the tottering height, while the disappointed builder found relief for his sorrow in anger—sorrow's best remedy after all.

glosses: To react with antimatter, producing gamma radiation and (for higher-mass reactants, especially composite particles such as protons) lighter particles (such as pions, muons, and neutrinos).
To treat as worthless, to vilify.

examples.text: of all the opinions which Antiquity hath had of men in gross, those which I most willingly embrace, and whereon I take most hold, are such as most vilifie, condemne, and annihilate us.

glosses: To render null and void; to abrogate.
